protocol: Fit initial65% of each recording; forecast remaining35%. All physical/geometry parameters fitted only to initial segment. ROI manually selected on first frame. All recordings excluded from neural training; this small subset informed tracker development, so it is not a blind test. Errors against image tracks, not independently annotated point truth.
limitations: Small IRIS subset; not complete official protocol.
IRIS nominal rope length0.50m is not necessarily pivot-to-bob-center effective length. Relative difference is not metrology-grade parameter error.
No acceleration/friction ground truth for sliding record.
Independent household recording length only author-reported.
IRIS-inspired finite-difference baseline is the analytical method; no published GPU/video baseline reproduced.

warnings: Pendulum assumes an upright fixed camera, planar point-mass motion, and viscous damping. Only k = g/L is recovered dynamically; g and L are not separately identifiable.
No scale calibration supplied. Pixel distances are not meters. Pendulum angles assume a front-facing circular motion plane.
